topics.response: For farmers, key schemes include PM-KISAN (income support), KCC (credit), and PMFBY (crop insurance).
PM-KISAN: Eligible farmer families receive Rs. 6000 per year in 3 equal installments.
Kisan Credit Card (KCC): Provides timely short-term credit for crop cultivation and allied activities.
PMFBY: Crop insurance scheme that protects farmers against crop loss due to natural risks.
Soil Health Card Scheme: Provides soil nutrient status and recommendations for better productivity.
PMKSY: Supports irrigation expansion and efficient water use under 'Per Drop More Crop'.
